summary: Voice-first and conversational products reduce capture friction, while coding tools can place transcripts directly into an agent session. Their output still needs a reviewable intent-normalization step.

items.text: Aider /voice: records speech, transcribes it and submits the resulting text into the coding conversation.
Wispr Flow: voice dictation with editing commands, custom vocabulary and application-aware formatting can capture long-form technical intent.
Superwhisper: local and cloud transcription modes plus custom vocabulary provide a configurable speech-to-text front end.
